entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 41642 of 2024
Applicant :- Vivek Atray Sharma Proprietor Of Vas Sports

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar,Vimal Kant
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jyoti Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State-O.P.
No.1.
2.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed praying for quashing the summoning order dated 21.03.2018 and NBW dated 19.09.2024 and its consequential orders passed by Judicial Magistrate, Second, Meerut as well as entire proceedings of Case No.4244 of 2016 u/s 420 IPC, P.S.T.P. Nagar, District-Meerut pending in the Court of A.C.J.M., Second, Meerut.

3. After arguing for sometime, the only prayer sought by the counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is willing to obtain bail after surrendering in the court below, and for that a protective direction may be issued to the concerned trial court to consider and decide the proposed bail application of the applicant.
Vivek Atray Sharma Proprietor Of Vas ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 May, 2025

entities.text: Vivek Atray Sharma Proprietor Of Vas ... vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. vehemently opposes the present application and submits that since the applicant is not cooperating in the court proceedings, NBW has been issued against the applicant and as such, he deserves no leniency by this Court.

5. Having gone through the rival submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, I do not see any illegality, impropriety and incorrectness in the impugned proceedings under challenge, and there is nothing else which may suggest that there is abuse of court's process.

There is no good ground to interfere in the impugned proceedings of the above mentioned case,
therefore, the prayer for quashing the summoning order dated 21.03.2018 and NBW dated 19.09.2024 and its consequential orders, is refused.

6. However, on the request of learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant wants to surrender in the court below and apply for bail, it is directed that in case the applicant surrenders within three weeks from today and applies for bail by moving an appropriate bail application, the same shall be considered and decided by the concerned trial court purely on its own merits.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 9.5.2025 Manish Himwan  Vivek Atray Sharma Proprietor Of Vas ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157274900/
